criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
criteria.evidence: Purdue GIS FID 791 identifies a cooperative at 608 Waldron Street; the Acacia contact/history and official chapter imagery support the building identity. The source massing shell is preserved. Fresh-open evaluated primary shell bounds are X [-334.714,-315.275], Y [342.136,370.629], Z [0,9.45] m (19.44 x 28.49 m footprint envelope). The evidence record itself identifies a Shape__Area conflict, and WGS84 source ring extents converted by the documented approximate transform do not reconcile cleanly to the shell bounds; the exact structural footprint therefore remains only partially verified.
findings: Resolve/document the GIS area and projected-footprint conflict with a top-down overlay or authoritative survey before claiming verified footprint.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
criteria.evidence: The asset is stored in direct-linked campus coordinates with identity collection offset and primary object location (0,0,0), satisfying the simple-massing convention. The saved evidence explicitly says the facade bearing is unverified and the porch position is estimated; no geotagged facade or current orthophoto comparison substantiates its rotation or sub-building placement. Envelope bounds are inspectable, but the footprint conflict also weakens dimensional verification.
findings: Verify the facade bearing and asset centroid/footprint against a current orthophoto or surveyed GIS overlay; record orientation and translation residuals.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.evidence: Official chapter drawings in the saved source set show three above-grade floor levels with elevations 100 ft, 110 ft 7 in, and 119 ft 10 in; elevation imagery supports a steep shingle roof, dormers and chimney. The saved model bounds give a 9.45 m overall primary-shell height. Roof geometry and overall height are modeled estimates, not surveyed/as-built dimensions.
findings: Overall height and roof profile remain estimates because the available plans are renovation/project drawings and no as-built height measurement was found.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
criteria.evidence: The exterior render contains the brick tower with vertical ACACIA letters, a porch/sign arch, chimney, steep roof, dormers, windows and a gabled end. Direct visual comparison to the official front photo shows major facade mismatches: the modeled visible upper facade is brick where the reference has prominent cream panels and dark half-timber framing; the tall right gable is nearly blank rather than detailed; the entrance/porch proportions and window arrangement are simplified. The exterior render also shows a large uninterrupted brick side wall. The interior render is a low-contrast top-down cutaway in which walls obscure most room detail; some beds, partitions and labels are present but it does not substantiate convincing interior fidelity.
findings: Rebuild the source-facing upper facade as cream infill with the photographed dark timber pattern; match the central entrance, porch opening, gable and window rhythm to the reference.
Add an interior view that makes the rooms legible, with material and furnishing detail; current pale overhead render is difficult to assess.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.evidence: Fresh-open asset has the expected scene/collection/stable ID, 489 objects (483 meshes), 12 in-file mesh materials, no external linked libraries, and 0 unpacked absolute-path image dependencies. The material audit reports 0 meshes with missing slots. The evidence folder contains raw GIS JSON, official chapter page snapshots, plans, a facade photo, and exterior/interior renders. Procedural materials are local to the asset.

evidence.fresh_open: passed in a new Blender 5.2.3 background process by opening the saved asset directly

findings: Overall score is below the 8/10 passing threshold.
The strongest evidence-backed improvements are the front-facing half-timber facade and measured GIS placement/orientation; do not treat the current completion as a pass.
